blocks.heading: Education Loan Secured or Unsecured
rows: Up to ₹4 lakh
No security and no margin money (your own share of the fee). Banks are told not to ask for collateral at this size.
Usually a parent or guardian signs with you as co-borrower.
Unsecured in plain words
₹4 lakh to ₹7.5 lakh
Usually a third-party guarantee and no property. The credit guarantee scheme below can remove even the guarantee.
Parent as co-borrower, plus a guarantor who agrees to repay if the borrowers do not.
Unsecured, but a named person must repay if you cannot
Above ₹7.5 lakh
Property or a fixed deposit of enough value, such as a house, a plot or a bank deposit.
Parent as co-borrower, and the pledged asset.
Secured

blocks.heading: Route to Try First

PM-Vidyalaxmi, applied for through a bank or the Vidya Lakshmi portal

The guarantee takes the place of security.
An unsecured offer from a bank or NBFC, priced against a secured one
A higher rate, stricter checks on the co-borrower and their credit record.
The gap is above ₹7.5 lakh and only a secured loan is on offer

blocks.heading: Large Loans That Are Still Collateral-Free

figures.label: Allocated Budget Share
figures.source: This lowers your cost, not the collateral rule. PM-Vidyalaxmi gives 3% interest subvention (the government pays that share of the interest) during the moratorium on loans up to ₹10 lakh, when family income is up to ₹8 lakh.

blocks.heading: Secured Loan Cost Less? a Rupee Check

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: That half-point gap is about ₹33,000 over the whole repayment, and a full-point gap is about ₹66,000. Interest during the moratorium comes on top. If the whole amount were paid out on day one and interest ran as simple interest, five years at 9.40% would add about ₹4.7 lakh, though real loans are paid out in instalments, so the true figure is usually lower.

blocks.heading: Pay for a Degree with a Loan

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: An illustration, not a real fee: take a family whose whole education budget is ₹20 lakh, so the suggested fee is about ₹2 lakh and the caution starts near ₹4 lakh. A degree that needs ₹12 lakh of borrowing sits far above both, so it needs strong proof for this course and college, such as a checked placement median, a licence requirement, or lab and clinical access. Whatever is left should pay for tools, practice and a reserve.

items.text: "Secured is always the better deal because the rate is lower." Sometimes the saving is small next to the risk to the asset.

blocks.heading: Unsecured Mean for You in Practice

items.text: The bank holds a claim on your asset until the loan is cleared.
The rate is often lower, but the gap can be small, as the rupee check below shows.
The bank values the asset and checks the papers first, which takes time and costs money.
If repayment fails, the bank can act against the asset.
